acceptance.description: Define accessible repeated-value presentation/grouping across nested raw values and dependent columns.

Grid-owned span-aware table-to-matrix calculation used by tableMap, colgroup removal, more and resize; cannot be removed as unused. Modern private topology compiler/native cell collections replace its used role; generic public conversion overload needs a compatibility recipe.

Grid-owned colgroup/header/body/footer element matrix supplies sizing, hide/show and empty colspan. Current plans retain native topology internally; no public TableMap handle. Public introspection is an additional crosswalk obligation.

Derives header data-id from body field IDs and maps spanned columns. Current explicit data-column keys are distinct from data-field paths/DOM IDs; sort/filter/group mapping still needs typed ownership.

Copies col widths into header/footer cells, strips scope and removes colgroups for resize. Used legacy workaround is replaced by native retained colgroups and exact restoration; preserving width/associations is the acceptance obligation.
Keeps a configured count of left columns visually fixed and uses correction/root-container settings. Authored sticky CSS and keyed state need complete pinning, responsive/scroll and disposal proof.

Creates separate header/body/footer wrappers; fixed footer, scroll lock, progressive scroll and height-resize are composed here. One native table/sticky CSS replaces copied/split layout mechanics only after equivalent workflows are validated.
Pointer/touch height resizing accounts for footer height; CSS sizing alone does not preserve the interactive feature. Accessible authored height interaction remains a required contract.
Generates column chooser/check-all/counts plus per-row detail Popup/Form, previous/next and validation on navigation/close. Column state alone does not cover generated chooser or detail navigation.

Legacy horizontal drag bars synchronize header/body/footer sizes and sortLock. Native preferred widths plus authored pointer/keyboard controls are implemented under ongoing optimized-layout/stage validation; no complete option-edge closure.

Header click toggles raw-data direction and rebinds; sortableItem can contain markup. setSort comparator/aria-sort exists, automatic authored activation/direction recipe and filter/rebind edges remain.
Column distinct-value panels provide selection/search/counts and full/partial/empty indicators over a cloned filter dataset. setFilter predicate does not implement that UI/workflow.

Equal adjacent values suppress repeated cell content/borders conditioned on preceding merge columns. This differs from authored header rowspan and from actual native body rowspan; no current repeated-data merge contract.

Delegated spreadsheet-like paste uses tab/newline/quoted-cell parsing and val calls, skips readonly/disabled fields. Required bulk contract must preserve typed raw values and define transaction/failure/off-page/column-order semantics.

Overloads return all/raw shared wrapper, modified/status, selected or checked rows and optional property projection. Rows entries/changes provide part of this; selected/check sets and explicit legacy server projection remain open.
Caller retains the authored table/root and uses querySelector(All) instead of jQuery selector wrappers; global instance discovery remains separately open in core C13.
Caller-owned table.tHead/querySelector retains the real authored header; copied legacy header wrapper is unnecessary only when sticky/sort/filter/column outcomes remain.
Caller retains authored tr/template before bind; legacy mutable cloned tbody enables multi-line/template controls and detail/code-list customization that need a lifecycle-safe equivalent.

Getter returns selected row indexes; setter accepts scalar/array and replace/append flags, dispatches click selection and scrolls to last target. Current select(RowId|null)/selected() is single-ID only.
Getter/setter operates target checkbox indexes, scalar/array and replace/append independently of selection, with reveal. Boolean data-field editing is not this check state.

Replace/append and internal sort/filter/update call types schedule row creation, reset indicators/check-all, maintain paging limits, render localized empty state and invoke completion flags. Rows.replace/subscription/local paging cover only part.

Creates row from entered/authored defaults plus data via row Form, supports top/index insertion and row hooks/revert/optional selection/reveal. Rows.add appends a JSON copy but does not supply that workflow.

Inserted rows disappear; existing rows are marked rowStatus delete and remain visibly marked; notifies DataSync. Rows.remove tracks deletion but Grid hides removed entries, so visibility/save/revert semantics remain open.
Option-gated per-row/array/all revert invokes before/after row hooks and row Form snapshots. Rows.revert provides central data operation; draft/status/deleted view and callback parity remain.

Legacy returns boolean, validates given rendered row or invalid/insert/update row Forms and optionally reveals last failure. Current ValidationResult includes issues and all/off-page row validation; interaction/scope/reveal crosswalk remains.

Getter/setter delegates to row Form when rendered and writes directly otherwise; new Rows.set fixes intended off-page change notification. Raw grouped values/parser/validation behavior and legacy payload mapping remain.
Used NU.ui.iteration.move changes data/DOM order and paging bookkeeping; setSort is a derived view rather than store movement.
Used iteration.copy aliases the same row object and cloned Form instance; modern support must create independent values/identity and insertion tracking, repairing this defect.

Accepts numeric column index or array in implementation; restores widths/display/span counts in header/body/footer/template and empty colspan. Modern hidden=false full state uses stable keys; chooser/empty/multi-line edges remain open.

Accepts numeric column index or array in implementation; reduces spanned groups and updates empty colspan. Current keyed state detaches hidden native cells/cols and keeps at least one visible; migration and additional legacy edges need closure.

Explicit ESM bindGrid plus caller-owned roots/templates replaces aliases but multi-line and customization outcomes remain required.

Constructor deep-merges global Grid options then local options; wrapHandler composes local/global onBeforeSelect,onSelect,onBind. Arbitrary configured/local extension keys are outside literal inventory. Current app-owned typed binder options/rules/messages need an explicit consistent default/composition recipe.

Merged locale message object supplies empty/search/selectAll/data-filter/more/column/show-hide/previous/next text. Current authored labels/status can localize these outcomes; no global Grid message object or integrated empty/menu/detail workflow is claimed.
Merged sortableItem asc/desc strings may contain markup; legacy swaps labels. Native aria-sort and authored labels replace presentation mechanics while correct direction/activation remain required.

Rows are NU.form instances. Formatter/validator HTML tuples and global/custom catalogs are reached transitively; field-to-tuple fRules/vRules differ from modern rule-name-to-function RuleSet. Grid omits forwarding those declared object options, a defect to repair rather than permission to drop their intended capability.

Runtime-added limit/defSize/isBinding coordinate progressive scroll, append, queued/reentrant bind and completion; all rendered pages accumulate. Modern local paging/released records does not certify progressive loading or real virtualization.

Declared callbacks expose Grid this, row indexes/elements/whole data and completion flags; runtime mutates beforeRow before after-selection callback and fires onSelect after veto. Intended modern typed transitions/hooks need deterministic ordering, RowId and owned cleanup.

Selection click ignores check-target controls; multi selection toggles independent rows and does not implement Shift/Ctrl range. Checks are DOM-target state independent of selected classes. check-all targets rendered rows; legacy removeProp/removeAttr clearing defects must be repaired, with explicit modern scope and mixed state.

Shared row Form performs raw/group values, defaults, display, validation and rowStatus. Grid bind and add pass different unbind/cache/tpBind options; current Form capabilities do not automatically reach Grid. Per-row names/labels/controls and independent screen ownership need evidence.

NT.aop creates components dynamically and recovers row index from repeated row elements; grouped controls use name-based targets. Current arbitrary DOM listeners cannot recover private Grid RowId maps; typed owned row action hook and binding-before-action order remain required even if parser mechanism is retired.

Constructor registers Grid DataSync and external updates call update. Current caller-owned Rows subscription is its central replacement; selected/check/status views, completion suppression and field hook order remain open.

Referenced helpers are Grid-owned dependencies reached through UI/row Forms, not unused standalone libraries. Native DOM/CSS/pointer handling, private topology and typed data projection may replace them locally after preserving owning outcomes. Regex/selector and global message utilities have dynamic paths beyond static reference lists.

more bundles two workflows: column chooser and editable detail dialog. Detail includes hidden fields, shares dataset, validates navigation and vetoes close. Authored column controls are a partial replacement; Popup/Form foundations do not finish row-detail behavior.

Current column contract keeps real header/footer/cell/colgroup nodes, validates native span membership and continuity, adjusts visible groups and restores exactly. It replaces split/copy geometry under ongoing validation; multi-line body records and repeated-value merging are separate missing features.

Legacy paste loops through rendered row elements then val; off-page targets can be written without RowStatus/notification. Required modern paste must reconcile current column order, parsers/drafts, atomic or reported partial failures, notification bounds and future virtualized rows.

User-required six Grid capabilities remain obligations. Reorder and bounded scroll virtualization are explicit added requirements; no historical reorder/range gesture or virtualization implementation is inferred from legacy multiselect/scrollPaging. Range semantics are a modern planned selection contract, not certified legacy behavior.

Mutable wrapper sharing/projection/save rows remain used application workflows. Current immutable Rows/change records require explicit tested wire conversion; selected/checked values are separate state families. Legacy selected/checked projection callback arguments bug is repaired around declared intent, not silently preserved or removed.

omission_groups.condition: Grid templates, code lists, row event context and binding-before-action behavior stay required; no duplicate approval request or unused claim.

read_proxy.meaning: Unique file byte/hash/AST inputs and selected excerpt review proxy only. It is not actual model context, tokens, full-file semantic reading or token savings; repeated excerpts and parser-library internals are excluded.

verification.current_snapshot_note: Parent froze artifact code before this final source snapshot. This P0 audit records hashes/structural mapping only and does not rerun or recertify runtime/package gates; other documentation may continue changing.

inheritance.member_static: For member entries only, omitted static is false; static:true is explicit.
inheritance.rule: Entries inherit entry_defaults. Profile IDs resolve owner/current/status and all profile acceptance cases; specific note/status/acceptance_additions refine that inherited mapping. A mapped entry can reference multiple owners. Omitted arrays contain no recorded additional evidence, not proof of absence.
inheritance.source_rule: legacy_line and option-reader line/expression refer to legacy-ui unless source_id is specified. Source IDs resolve through sources. No source body is embedded.
inheritance.lexical_readers: Each lexical_readers object maps an exact uncomputed option expression to its distinct observed legacy-ui line numbers, preserving all recorded reader anchors. Missing readers mean none recorded by this static scope, not unused.
inheritance.format: Surface and dynamic records occupy one JSON line each to reduce indentation; expand entry_defaults/profile references when reviewing. Source/option reader references keep every recorded anchor.

entry_defaults.acceptance: all cases and planned refs of listed profiles
entry_defaults.reachability_policy: Direct, contextual, transitive, aliases, declarations, configuration and external consumers remain relevant. Static absence does not establish unused; no entry is authorized for deletion.
